decisions.reason: As an add-on tied to the firm’s core web-map platform, with an own page and repeated release activity at launch, it still benefits from sunk development effort and earlier public commitment, so management is more likely to continue than reverse course.

This search plugin had lower visibility and is easier to sacrifice than the more prominently launched products, but because it remains close to the established offering and likely required limited extra maintenance, management would still tend to retain it absent clear failure evidence.

Its prominent home-page launch and role in improving mobile map usability fit the firm’s integrated geospatial direction, making management inclined to justify the prior investment and keep supporting it.

Mobile field data capture is closely aligned with customer workflows and the firm’s broader solution portfolio, and its dedicated presentation signals enough commitment that management would be reluctant to withdraw it now.
